name: Scriv
text: The Alima video is a single point of failure—if the link breaks or the description is incomplete, we lose the artifact and the day’s progress. Kaedim’s AI tools, while not free, offer structured 3D asset pipelines that are more resilient to link rot and can be validated against internal benchmarks. Settle this by running a 2-hour spike on Kaedim’s free tier to confirm if their output meets the artifact standard; if it does, we pivot—if not, we default to Alima but demand a mirrored backup.
